description.value: A 101-room waterfront resort situated on Kootenay Lake in Nelson, within walking distance of downtown and backed by views of the Selkirk Mountains. The property features on-site dining at Port701 Marinaside and is surrounded by opportunities for kayaking, boating, and exploring the broader Kootenay region. Its central Nelson location makes it a comfortable overnight base for cyclists passing through the area.

raw_osm.name: Prestige Lakeside Resort, BW Premier Collection

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel at 701 Lakeside Drive, Nelson BC with 101 guest rooms, on-site dining at Port701 Marinaside, and waterfront location; page filter tags in the title ('free-breakfast', 'free-high-speed-internet') provide amenity evidence. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or other cycling-specific facilities anywhere in the fetched content. Notably, the OSM name references 'BW Premier Collection' but the website page title reads 'Prestige Lakeside Resort - WorldHotels Elite', indicating a likely rebranding.
